# SingleSourceOfTruthMetric

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A standardized, authoritative definition of the CST metric (SSOT) that ensures consistency across experiments and topologies. Provides a common reference for reproducible experiments and stability analysis, enabling cross-domain validation between TCC and iNEST.
